card.name: Punctuation before braille in format lists
card.fires_on: Commas, 'and', 'or' and 'in' that come just before the word braille (or a similar format) in lists of accessible formats for blind or print-disabled readers.

modes.label: List separators
modes.description: A comma or 'and' in a list of accessible formats, where braille is likely to come next or just came before.
modes.example: Formats are Braille<<,>> Large Print, Audio and Digital text.

modes.label: Linking words before braille
modes.description: A short linking word such as 'and', 'in' or 'or' right before the word braille.
modes.example: repository of instructional materials<< in>> braille and large print.

modes.label: Blind-services names
modes.description: The word 'and' inside the name of a library for the blind.
modes.example: the Library for the Blind<< and>> Physically Handicapped.

card.writes: It pushes the model toward predicting 'Br' (as in Braille) and 'screen', and away from 'access' words.
card.plain: It fires on the small words and commas that lead into 'braille' in lists of formats for blind readers.
